options.counterfactual: No bounded increasing sequence of positive contractions can have a fixed strictly positive quasitrace on every successive difference, so the least-upper-bound condition is unnecessary and G is empty.
options.approach: Seek a quasitracial exhaustion theorem stating that positive elements with bounded partial sums have quasitraces tending to zero. Check its precise hypotheses rather than relying on trace telescoping.
